module: Flowgraph node "Rally Info Panel" (category repeat_instant, tag rally/ui/start/screen, ui icon). Builds the consolidated rally start screen panel and adds it via mgr.modules.ui:addUIElement({type = 'rallyStageInfo', ...}): statistics (distance in km and surface breakdown, read from the mission's driveline file), mission description blurb, rules (recovery with or without repair, flip, stop check, or loop rules: liaison, service park, liaison speed, false starts, time control penalties). Inputs: flow, isLoop (bool: loop rules if true, single stage rules otherwise). Output: flow. Sets the page icon 'roadInfo'.
notes: The repair on recovery comes from activity.lastUserSettings.rallyRepairVehicleOnRecovery, otherwise from the rallyRepairVehicleOnRecovery setting, otherwise true.
In loop mode, also displays SS/liaison/total distances (via the loop manager) and the list of stages (stage1..4_rallyStage).

readStats.desc: Reads the driveline stats from the rally manager, or from the mission's spline file.

readStatsForFolder.desc: Reads the stats from the driveline file of a mission folder.

formatStats.desc: Formats the stats: distance ("%.2f km") and rounded surfaces > 0 % sorted by descending value.

buildStats.desc: Formatted stats of the current stage.

buildLoopStats.desc: Stage, liaison and total distances of the rally loop (formatted in km).

returns.desc: {specialStageDistance, liaisonDistance, totalDistance} or nil if the schedule is invalid.

buildLoopStages.desc: List of the loop's stages (name, distance, surfaces) from the stage1..4_rallyStage fields of the mission.

getServiceParkSpeedLimit.desc: Displayable service park speed limit (30 km/h by default).

buildRules.desc: Builds the list of rules (translation keys or {txt, context}) according to isLoop and the repair.

repairEnabled.desc: Whether the recovery repairs the vehicle.

work.desc: Every frame: copies flow and adds the rallyStageInfo UI element.
